zh.title: 中華電信推動嘉義無人機物流計畫 展示送餐服務
zh.summary: 中華電信宣布於嘉義縣推動無人機物流計畫，並於活動中亮相送餐服務。
body: 中華電信於2026年8月10日宣布，攜手點點全球與新樂飛無人機等單位推動「嘉義亞創無人機物流計畫」，在嘉義縣太保市及朴子市建置示範場域，並於「2026嘉義縣無人機日」首次亮相無人機送餐服務，實現配送流程自動化。
業者表示，該計畫獲得經濟部產業技術司相關計畫支持，截至目前已完成近1200件配送任務，累積約120小時飛行時數與1100公里飛行里程。中華電信並建置全台首條5G空中廊道，透過多機協同技術提升遠端監管與整體營運效率。

en.title: Chunghwa Telecom Launches Drone Logistics Trial and Meal Delivery in Chiayi
en.summary: Chunghwa Telecom launched a UAV logistics demonstration project in Chiayi County, showcasing automated meal delivery services.
body: Chunghwa Telecom announced on August 10, 2026, that it has partnered with organizations including Point Click and NALEFLY to launch the Chiayi Asia UAV Logistics Plan. The initiative establishes a drone logistics demonstration zone across Taibao City and Puzi City in Chiayi County, showcasing automated drone meal delivery services during the 2026 Chiayi County Drone Day event.

Supported by the Ministry of Economic Affairs' Department of Industrial Technology, the project has completed nearly 1,200 delivery tasks, logging approximately 120 flight hours and 1,100 kilometers. Chunghwa Telecom also established Taiwan's first 5G aerial corridor and introduced multi-drone control technology allowing single-operator monitoring to improve operational efficiency.

zh.title: Airbus A321（B-LPX）觀測抵達桃園機場
zh.summary: 呼號 CRK283 之 A321 抵 RCTP；營運者未識別
body: 本站監測系統觀測到一架 Airbus A321 航空器於臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）完成抵達。公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，該機的註冊號為 B-LPX，ICAO hex 碼為 78929f，機型顯示名稱為 Airbus A321。確認抵達時間為 2026-08-10T13:52:39Z，抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival。
依本站觀測紀錄，該航班的呼號為 CRK283，營運者 ICAO 為 CRK，但營運者 IATA、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱及營運者所屬國家或地區均標示為未識別。在營運者身分未經官方確認的情況下，本報導僅以航空器型別與註冊號指稱該機，不對營運者身分進行推測。
本次觀測的主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 confirmed_by_two_sources。確認依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground，有效觀測筆數為 2 筆。首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-10T12:27:25Z。
機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP，機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。航空器 ICAO 機型代碼為 A321。事件 ID 為 fw-1153e755d3a6e6c2，資料類型為公開 ADS-B 觀測。
統計說明欄位指出，系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計。因此本報導不對該組合的罕見程度做出任何超出原始資料的判斷，僅如實呈現本站系統的觀測結果。
本報導所有事實均取自前述公開 ADS-B 觀測資料，不包含對航班目的、起飛機場、目的地機場、航線、乘客人數或任何營運計畫的推測。在營運者身分未經官方確認前，讀者不應將呼號 CRK283 或 ICAO 代碼 CRK 自行對應至任何特定航空公司。

en.title: Airbus A321 (B-LPX) Observed Arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan Int'l Airport
en.summary: A321 with callsign CRK283 arrived RCTP (TPE); operator unidentified
body: The site's monitoring system observed an Airbus A321 aircraft completing an arrival at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. Public ADS-B observation data shows the aircraft's registration as B-LPX, ICAO hex code as 78929f, and model display name as Airbus A321. The confirmed arrival time was 2026-08-10T13:52:39Z, with arrival determination classified as confirmed_arrival.

According to the site's observation records, the flight's callsign is CRK283 and the operator ICAO is CRK. However, the operator IATA code, operator name, operator Chinese name, and operator's country or region are all listed as unidentified. With the operator's identity unconfirmed by official sources, this report refers to the aircraft solely by its type and registration and does not speculate on the operator's identity.

The primary data source for this observation is Airplanes.live, with a secondary source of ADSB.lol, and the cross-confirmation status is confirmed_by_two_sources. The confirmation basis is that the aircraft was located within the airport geofence and alt_baro read ground, with 2 valid observation records. The first valid observation time was 2026-08-10T12:27:25Z.

The airport ICAO code is RCTP, and the airport name is Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. The aircraft ICAO type code is A321. The event ID is fw-1153e755d3a6e6c2, and the data type is public ADS-B observation.

The statistics note indicates that the system's observation history is still accumulating, with no comparable long-term statistics available. Accordingly, this report makes no judgment regarding the rarity of this combination beyond what the raw data states, presenting only the factual observation results from the site's system.

All facts in this report are drawn exclusively from the aforementioned public ADS-B observation data. This report does not include any speculation regarding the flight's purpose, origin airport, destination airport, route, passenger count, or any operational plan. Until the operator's identity is officially confirmed, readers should not independently associate the callsign CRK283 or the ICAO code CRK with any specific airline.
